primary.question: admission-policy effect (fixed validation-24 vs cohort-specific panels) under preserved knowledge, for two fixed search policies
primary.primary_endpoint: sealed-4 score of the final freeze's selection_panel_best, paired by block: panels vs fixed within each policy
secondary: selection-panel score of the final pick
panel query utilisation and cap hits
production energy per alloy and alloy
policy contrast within each admission policy

ablation.control: beam/fixed worlds are SHARED with the primary study (identical frozen configuration); not re-run
ablation.contrasts: bundle vs plain beam; each leave-one-out vs the full bundle (effect of the removed guard conditional on the other guards)

panel_rules.activation: panel k is active while lifecycle cohort k is current (boundaries every 60 ticks)
panel_rules.feedback: one admitted/not-admitted bit per submission plus the agent's own query count
panel_rules.comparison: child and its admission reference re-scored on the identical active panel at submission
panel_rules.older_artifacts: remain admitted and usable; their stored admission scores are never compared across panels
panel_rules.cost: a submission costs one credit and the usual energy in both admission policies

final_selection: at each freeze, the newest <=16 admitted or superseded workflows held by the cohort are scored on the shared selection-0 panel (observer-side; never shown to agents); the lowest is frozen as selection_panel_best. Same rule in every condition; evaluations are counted.
missing_data: a direction is reported only if at least 75% of expected worlds are eligible pairs AND the same side is lower in at least 75% of eligible pairs; otherwise 'no consistent difference' or 'insufficient eligible pairs'. Descriptive, not a significance test. Missing picks are never scored as zero; failed worlds are reported with reasons and excluded from pairs.
exclusions_and_stopping: all frozen blocks run; no replacement of difficult worlds; no early stopping; the study ends at its endpoint whatever the result
limitations_declared: one controller realisation per parameter combination (controller-by-environment variation partly confounded)
12 of 45 combinations of a finite task family; no open-world generalisation
agents, artifacts and transitions within a world are not independent replicates
